text: Japan's September exports rose 16.7% YoY versus 20.1% expected. Semiconductor exports increased 49.4%, with shipments to China up 8.6% and the U.S. up 22.9%. Imports rose 18.9%, including a 51.1% increase in petroleum imports and nearly 820% growth in U.S.-sourced petroleum.

meta.note: Reported trade changes are value-based; price and volume contributions are not separately identified.

text: U.K. annual inflation reached 3.5% in September, above the 3.4% forecast and 3.1% in August. Motor fuel prices rose 29.8% YoY. National debt exceeded £3T, while markets priced a 98% probability of a 25-basis-point Bank of England rate increase in November.

meta.note: The November rate increase remains market-implied rather than an enacted monetary policy decision.

text: SpaceX shares rose approximately 8% Wednesday following Q3 revenue of $14.6B, up 161% YoY, and net income of $4.4B. Rocket Lab, Intuitive Machines, and AST SpaceMobile also advanced. SpaceX and Tesla established board committees to evaluate a potential merger.

meta.note: The share-price movement is distinct from the previously logged Q3 operating results; merger approval remains unresolved.

text: France's 10-year government bond yield briefly exceeded 5%, its highest since 2002. The 2027 budget remains under negotiation in a divided parliament, with €54B in proposed spending cuts. The prior deficit stood at 5.1% of GDP against the EU's 3% benchmark. Nationwide protests remain active.

meta.note: Parliamentary budget divisions and sovereign yield movements are distinct structural layers within the event.

text: A New Mexico court ordered Meta to pay $25B following a jury finding of more than 43M unfair practices violations. The court reduced an initial $219.5B assessment and imposed 15% annual interest on the unpaid penalty. Meta disputes the ruling and plans to appeal.

meta.note: The penalty is court-ordered; appellate review remains unresolved, and final payment status is unspecified.

text: Meta reported Q3 revenue of $64.6B, up 26% YoY, with 3.64B daily active users. Annual capital expenditure guidance narrowed to $135B-$145B. Reality Labs recorded a $4.13B operating loss. Headcount fell 12% QoQ to approximately 66,000, while Muse reached 10M user setups.

meta.note: Advertising remains the primary revenue base; standalone Muse revenue and infrastructure returns are not quantified.
